protocol_version_note: The governing filename is summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md, while its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. The file was treated as authoritative because project precedence names this exact file.

source_integrity_findings.finding: Section 3.4 says DOACs may be appropriate after at least 6 to 12 months following bariatric surgery, while formal guidance statement 6 says VKA or a DOAC may be considered after at least 4 weeks of parenteral treatment. Both statements are preserved without reconciliation.
The governing file is named summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md, while its internal heading says Integrated Compact v3. Project precedence makes the named v4 file authoritative.

schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind. Formal ISTH SSC guidance statements are represented as author_conclusion atoms and tagged guideline_recommendation.
extraction_limitations: The publication is a secondary guidance communication. It did not enroll participants or generate the cited trial and observational results.
Selected quantitative results were retained when they materially support the guidance. They are tagged secondary_reported_result and anchored to the communication, not the primary cited study.
Not every numeric result or reference-level detail was atomized. Central independently reviewable claims, guidance statements, limitations, and load-bearing quantitative findings were prioritized.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human verification step is represented.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
sea_verdict: Read first for the 2021 guidance rationale; current-practice verification required before clinical use in 2026.
